name: Microsoft Teams
concept: Element dressed as Microsoft Teams across three eras: classic purple Teams (2020), the first Fluent 2 'new Teams' (2024) and Teams as it actually ships in November 2026 (light, dark and a clock-driven daylight variant). From that faithful core the family fans out to usable variants that keep Element's affordances, a speculative 2028 Copilot-glass Teams built on Microsoft's staged V21 violet ramp, and two hype takes: a comic strip and Night City cyberpunk.

limits: Element Call and widget iframes only get light/dark — Teams' meeting stage (centered toolbar, red Leave) is styled only on Element's frame around the iframe.
No real app bar: Element's SpacePanel lists spaces, not apps. The rail is styled like the Teams app bar (labels via attr(aria-label)), but its items stay Home + spaces.
Header tabs (Chat | Shared | Recap | +) do not exist in Element; the header buttons (threads, files/info, pins) are restyled into a tab-like strip; real tab semantics are not added.

Compound icons are inline SVG without per-icon classes; swapping to Fluent icons requires hiding the svg and painting a mask-image on the button, keyed by aria-label/class — only for ~30 high-visibility buttons, locale-dependent where aria-label is the only hook.
Teams' Fluent Emoji (animated 3D) cannot replace Element's Twemoji text rendering; we only point --emoji-font-family at local Segoe UI Emoji where present.
Presence dots: Matrix has no reliable presence on our homeserver; we show the dot only where Element renders presence (member list), never fake it on every avatar.
Own messages on the right exist only in Element's bubble layout; group/IRC layouts get the brand tint without moving the tile.
Default-avatar data-URL images (notifications, favicon) use Element's hard-coded palette.
Segoe UI / Segoe UI Variable are proprietary: used via local() only (Windows), Selawik is what Linux/macOS users see — metrics match, glyph shapes differ slightly.

variants.texture: halftone dots (radial-gradient 1.5px, 8px grid, 8% ink) on canvas; yellow #FFE14D panel gutters
variants.motion: speech bubbles pop in (scale .9→1, 150ms) on new messages only; 'PING!' burst on new mentions; all off under reduced motion
signature: messages as speech bubbles with ink tails pointing at the avatar
3px #111 outlines + hard 4px offset shadows on every panel
Bangers lettering for room names and dialog titles
starburst badges, red 'PING!' burst for mentions
halftone canvas, panel gutters like a comic page; Teams purple rail as the masthead

regions.shell: #0b0614 with faint 40px violet grid, scanline overlay above everything (pointer-events none)
regions.spaces: #07040d rail, cyan icons, selected = violet glowing left bar + chamfered tile
regions.roomlist: rows with chamfered hover, unread names cyan, preview mono
regions.header: Orbitron 18 uppercase name with glitch on hover, buttons as chamfered neon outline
regions.timeline: chamfered cards, own #241447 with violet edge, others #140c24 with cyan hairline; mono timestamps
regions.names-avatars: names in neon decorative ramp (violet, cyan, pink, yellow, lime, orange) on dark; avatars hexagon clip
regions.composer: terminal-style input, '>' prompt glyph, blinking block caret, violet glow on focus
regions.buttons: chamfered, violet fill + dark text or neon outline; hover = glow + 1px shift
regions.inputs: transparent with cyan bottom line, glow on focus
regions.dialogs: chamfered panel, Orbitron title, corner brackets, glitch-in once
regions.auth: full-bleed neon city gradient (violet→pink horizon), chamfered login card, 'JACK IN' button
regions.badges: pink #FF2E97 counts, mentions yellow #FCEE0A on black
regions.code: Share Tech Mono on #07040d, synthwave hljs (pink keywords, cyan strings)
regions.iframes: dark; frame gets neon chamfer border
regions.icons: Fluent regular icons in cyan, filled violet when active, drop-shadow glow
regions.motion: glitch on hover, caret blink, logo flicker; reduced motion = none
